name: Without Reviews Finder
author: samiur6688

sections.description:
Without Reviews Finder is a lightweight WordPress plugin that helps site administrators discover WordPress.org plugins that have not yet received any reviews.

Features:
– Displays results in a clean table:
– Plugin Name (linked to WordPress.org)
– Short Description
– Each search displays up to 50 plugins without reviews.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/without-reviews-finder directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Without Reviews Finder > Search Plugins Without Reviews in the admin menu.
  4. Click the Find Plugins button to retrieve and display plugins with no reviews.
  5. Use Search for More to fetch more results.
sections.faq:
How many plugins does it display per search?

Each search displays up to 50 plugins with no reviews.

Does it require any configuration?

No configuration is needed.
